svg.text: Sabiko vs C#: time ratio over time (p50, Sabiko / C#)
Below 1.00x = Sabiko faster. 2 weekly runs, 2026-11-07 to 2026-11-09, latest dbc6cee8eebe on GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest (shared runner).
Steady state = in-process time per iteration after warm-up; end to end = process wall time per launch, start-up included.
Geometric mean over each run's benchmarks (11 in the latest)
